title: HF LCR Meter 11050 Series
seoDescription: High frequency LCR meter for chip inductor and passive component testing.

props.title: HF LCR Meter 11050 Series
paragraphs: High frequency LCR meter for chip inductor and passive component testing.

props.body:
- Test frequency: 75kHz ~ 30MHz (11050-30M), 1kHz ~ 10MHz (11050), 60Hz ~ 5MHz (11050-5M)
- Test level: 10mV ~ 5V
- Basic accuracy: 0.1%
- Dual frequency mode
